mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_ai_quality ( ticket_ai_quality_id, project_id, repository_id, ticket_id, ai_quality_rate, status, delete_flag, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by ) VALUES ( #{ticketAiQualityId}, #{projectId}, #{repositoryId}, #{ticketId}, #{aiQualityRate}, #{status}::record_status, #{deleteFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_ai_quality SET ai_quality_rate = #{aiQualityRate}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE ticket_ai_quality_id = #{ticketAiQualityId} AND delete_flag = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
